tagline: Leading regional bank serving customers across key U.S. and Asian markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income is the primary driver of the company's revenue, representing 87% of total revenue in 2025, with an increase of $274 million (12%) compared to 2024.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Interest income earned on interest-earning assets less interest expense paid on interest-bearing liabilities
kpis.description: Net interest income before provision for credit losses. Metric tracked annually by the company's analysts, with historical data over the last four years.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Ratio of net interest income to interest-earning assets, expressed as a percentage of average earning assets
kpis.signal: Increase of 14 basis points in 2025 compared to 2024

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average total assets, expressed as a percentage
kpis.signal: Increase of 10 basis points in 2025 compared to 2024

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average shareholders' equity, expressed as a percentage
kpis.signal: Increase of 8 basis points in 2025 compared to 2024

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio

kpis.signal: Improvement of 96 basis points in 2025 compared to 2024

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk due to mismatches between the repricing dates and maturities of assets and liabilities. Approximately 58% of loans are variable-rate, creating significant exposure to changes in the Federal Reserve's policy rates.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk associated with its $56.9 billion loan portfolio. However, the provision for credit losses decreased from $174 million to $160 million in 2025, indicating an improvement in asset quality.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company maintains a stable deposit ratio with organic deposit growth of 6% in 2025. The deposit funding ratio is sound with $67.1 billion in deposits against $56.9 billion in loans.

risks.title: Economic and Macroeconomic Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade policies, tariffs, and government shutdowns raise concerns about inflation, supply chain disruptions, and economic slowdown. Economic uncertainty could reduce consumer spending and slow business investment.
